description: pLDDT profile of LRCH1 and ranking of CH domains by conservation of the cryo-EM F-actin interface
code:
import numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
pl={}; seqmap={}
for ln in open('ch_work/af/AF-Q9Y2L9.pdb'):
    if ln.startswith('ATOM') and ln[12:16].strip()=='CA':
        i=int(ln[22:26]); pl[i]=float(ln[60:66]); seqmap[i]=AA3.get(ln[17:20].strip(),'X')
x=np.array(sorted(pl)); y=np.array([pl[i] for i in x])
print("mean pLDDT 540-575 (pre-CH linker): %.1f"%y[(x>=540)&(x<=575)].mean())
print("mean pLDDT 576-692 (CH domain)   : %.1f"%y[(x>=576)&(x<=692)].mean())
print("mean pLDDT 693-728 (C-term)      : %.1f"%y[(x>=693)&(x<=728)].mean())
print("region 548-600:", "".join(seqmap[i] for i in range(548,601)))

# canonical CH1 N-terminal actin-binding motif check (TFTxW / KWxN)
import re
refs={'UTRN_CH1':'FSDIIKSRSDEHNDVQKKTFTKWINARFSKSGKPPINDMF',
      'FLNA_CH1':'PATEKDLAEDAPWKKIQQNTFTRWCNEHLKCV',
      'ACTN1_CH1':'DPAWEKQQRKTFTAWCNSHLRKAGTQIENIEEDFR',
      'DMD_CH1':'MLWWEEVEDCYEREDVQKKTFTKWVNAQFSKFGKQHIENLFSDL',
      'CNN1_CH':None,'LRCH1_CH':None}
dom=json.load(open('ch_work/domains.json'))
print("\nN-terminal 40 aa of each CH domain (canonical CH1 ABS1 region 'TFTxW'):")
for k in ['LRCH1_HUMAN_CH','LRCH2_HUMAN_CH','LRCH3_HUMAN_CH','LRCH4_HUMAN_CH','LRCH_DROME_CH',
          'CNN1_HUMAN_CH','TAGL_HUMAN_CH','VAV_HUMAN_CH','IQGA1_HUMAN_CH',
          'ACTN1_HUMAN_CH1','FLNA_HUMAN_CH1','PLST_HUMAN_CH1','PARVA_HUMAN_CH1']:
    s=dom[k]['seq']
    hit=re.search(r'[TKR]F[TS].W',s)
    print(f"  {k:18s} {s[:42]}   TFTxW-like motif: {hit.group(0) if hit else 'ABSENT'}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,7),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1,1.3]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(x,y,lw=0.9,color='#2b6cb0')
ax.axvspan(576,692,color='#f6ad55',alpha=.35,label='CH domain (576-692)')
ax.axvspan(98,304,color='#9ae6b4',alpha=.35,label='LRR region (98-304)')
ax.axvspan(693,728,color='#feb2b2',alpha=.4,label='hydrophobic C-terminus')
ax.set_xlabel('LRCH1 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('AlphaFold pLDDT'); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right'); ax.set_title('AlphaFold confidence across human LRCH1 (Q9Y2L9)')

ax=axes[1]
d=pd.read_csv('ch_work/iface_conservation.csv')
d=d[~d.domain.isin(['UTRN_HUMAN_CH1','UTRN_HUMAN_CH2','DMD_HUMAN_CH1','DMD_HUMAN_CH2'])]
p=d.pivot(index='domain',columns='ref',values='pct_same_class')
p['mean']=p.mean(axis=1); p=p.sort_values('mean')
cols=['#c53030' if 'LRCH' in i else ('#2f855a' if i in ('FLNA_HUMAN_CH1','ACTN1_HUMAN_CH1','PLST_HUMAN_CH1','PLST_HUMAN_CH3','PARVA_HUMAN_CH1') else '#718096') for i in p.index]
ax.barh(range(len(p)),p['mean'],color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(p))); ax.set_yticklabels(p.index,fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel('% of F-actin interface positions with conserved residue class\n(mean over utrophin CH1 / filamin A CH1 cryo-EM interfaces)')
ax.set_title('LRCH CH domains do not retain the CH1 F-actin interface')
import matplotlib.patches as mp
ax.legend(handles=[mp.Patch(color='#2f855a',label='validated F-actin-binding CH1'),
                   mp.Patch(color='#718096',label='other CH domains'),
                   mp.Patch(color='#c53030',label='LRCH family')],fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
